sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for Fast On-Device Agents - liquid.ai
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: an open-weight 24B reasoning model with 2B active parameters, built for fast, private on-device agents. Beats Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on LiveClaw.

sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning model with only 2B active parameters, built for fast, private agents on-device. It is the largest and final model in the LFM2.5 family, which now spans two orders of magnitude: from LFM2.5-230M to LFM2.5-24B-A2B.

sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight LFM2.5-24B-A2B for On-Device ...
sources.snippet: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B on October 13, 2026, an open-weight 24B-parameter reasoning model with 2B active parameters built for agents that run on-device. The company published the base and post-trained checkpoints on Hugging Face and detailed the release in a post on the Hugging Face blog.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: 24B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 2B active parameters — our largest model for laptops and single-GPU applications ← Back to Text Models LFM2-24B-A2B is Liquid AI's largest Mixture-of-Experts model, combining 24B total parameters with only 2B active parameters per forward pass.
